name: Mukerem Shifa
headline: I build AI systems that can show their work, and the products that carry them.
intro: I work at the seam between a model and the system that has to carry it: retrieval that cites the passage it answered from, permissions enforced at query time rather than after ranking, and interfaces that stay usable at 320 pixels. Most of what I build is the unglamorous plumbing around the model, which is usually where the product actually lives.
